    AI Overview
    Yes, the U.S. stock market (
    NYSE and Nasdaq) is closed on Good Friday. 
    • 2026 Date: The market is closed on Friday, April 3, 2026, in observance of Good Friday.
    • Bond Market: The bond market will close early at 2 p.m. ET on Thursday (the day before Good Friday) and will remain closed on Good Friday.
    • Reopening: Trading will resume on Monday, April 6, 2026.
    • Context: Good Friday is not a federal holiday, but it is a standard, long-standing market holiday. 
    Note for Other Services: 
    • Banks: Most banks are open, as Good Friday is not a Federal Reserve holiday.
    • Mail: The U.S. Postal Service (USPS) will be open and delivering mail.
